title: Vortex Download Manager v1.0.4
changelog: High-Performance Download Engine Tuning: Achieved 290+ MB/s throughput with optimized lockless chunk streaming
Zero-Copy Instant File Assembly: Single-segment downloads now finalize instantaneously via zero-copy atomic filesystem moves
C-Level Cryptographic Hashing: 2.3x faster SHA-256, MD5, and SHA-1 checksum verifications via native C file_digest
Sub-millisecond Event-Driven Wakeups: Replaced polling sleep loops with immediate event notifications for zero latency file completion
TCP Window Buffer Scaling: Tuned 8MB socket receive buffers and 2MB send buffers with TCP_NODELAY for multi-gigabit connections
Stop & Resume Queue Fixes: Fixed Stop action vs Pause behavior and cleared stale resumption journals when re-downloading deleted items
